headline: Furnace Repair | Search is the cheapest place for the next lead: $62.11 on Google's own simulation against a $68.88 yardstick. Grow it from $3,480 to $4,305 a month.
AC Installation | Search gives back $825 a month once you confirm what an install lead is worth: at the same value per lead it costs 2.66 times the yardstick.
All spend sits on one platform. Microsoft Ads is the channel to test next; a fair test needs about $3,100 for 30 results at 1.5 x T.

assumptions: Gains use the line's marginal cost per result from Google's simulation of the last 7 days; losses use the line's own cost per result, which overstates the loss a little because a line's last dollars buy the least.
Every lead is worth the same until you give values per line.

channel_mix.why: Google Search works for this business and the buyer searches at the moment of need. Microsoft Ads sells the same intent on another network, and the Google campaigns can be imported to start.
not_now: Meta: urgent repairs start with a search, not a feed; revisit for installs and seasonal tune-up offers after the search test.
LinkedIn: a business-to-business channel; this buyer is a homeowner.
